name: BOMME STUDIO Clothing Manufacturer
old_description: Cut-and-sew production • Custom artist merchandise • Private label • High-volume programs
about:
BOMME STUDIO operates as a clothing manufacturer in Los Angeles, California. The company provides full-package production, cut-make-trim (CMT) services, private label programs, and custom merchandise solutions for established brands. While its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, the studio has built a reputation for managing the complete apparel manufacturing lifecycle from development through final delivery.

Its core capabilities span product development, technical design, patternmaking and digitizing, sampling and fit development, cutting, sewing, assembly, quality control, finishing, and bulk production management. The company coordinates both domestic and international factory partners, offering fabric and trim sourcing for full-package programs. Minimum order quantities start at 150 units per style for cut-and-sew work and 600 units per style for full-package production, with high-volume programs also supported.

BOMME STUDIO serves fashion, music, and performance apparel brands, including activewear, athleisure, loungewear, streetwear, underwear, premium t-shirts, hoodies, and sweatshirts. Clients range from high-growth lifestyle labels to artists and tours requiring custom merch. The studio’s private label catalog provides ready-made blanks in 100% cotton and other fabrics for brands seeking faster market entry.

The company emphasizes disciplined workflows, transparent communication, and rigorous quality control across all stages. Its Los Angeles base allows hands-on oversight, while a vetted network of U.S. and global factories ensures category-specific expertise and scalable capacity. Standard timelines run two to six weeks for development, two to four weeks for sampling, and six to twelve weeks for bulk production, with accelerated options available when capacity permits.

name: Bachoco USA Plants - OKC
old_description: Founded more than 80 years ago, OK Foods has grown from a livestock and poultry feed manufacturer to join one of the world’s leading chicken producers, Bachoco.
about:
Bachoco USA operates a poultry processing plant in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, as part of a vertically integrated business that traces its roots back more than 80 years. The operation originated as OK Foods, a livestock and poultry feed manufacturer in the Fort Smith, Arkansas region, before becoming part of Industrias Bachoco, one of the world's largest chicken producers. The company is a subsidiary of the Mexican conglomerate and runs USDA‑certified facilities across the United States.

The facility produces a range of chicken products under the Bachoco®, Tenderbird® and Top Chick® brands, including boneless skinless breasts (IQF, hormone‑free), seasoned bone‑in thighs, fully cooked strips and party wings. Processing steps cover slaughter, deboning, individually quick freezing, marinating, cooking, seasoning and packaging. The company reports 4,000‑plus team members company‑wide and emphasizes a farm‑to‑table supply chain that controls feed, breeding, hatching, grow‑out and processing.

Customers span food‑service distributors, quick‑service restaurant chains, retail grocery accounts, commodity buyers and private‑label programs. The business‑to‑business side sells bulk and portioned items to distributors and national QSR accounts, while the retail arm places branded trays in supermarkets nationwide.

Bachoco states that its differentiation rests on vertical integration, animal‑welfare standards, sustainability initiatives and a food‑safety program that delivers antibiotic‑free, hormone‑free chicken verified by USDA inspection and third‑party testing.

name: Bad Ass Metal Fab
old_description: 5lb Propane tank bracket for Flame King style (only works with 5lb tanks)
about:
Bad Ass Metal Fab, operating under the BAMF brand, is based in Grass Valley, California. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources.

The shop centers on CNC laser cutting and tube laser cutting, offering custom design and prototyping services alongside a proprietary product line. That line includes carbon steel cookware — 10x10 and 10x20 griddles and grill pans — and truck accessories such as a behind-the-grille light bar bracket for 2005–2023 Toyota Tacomas and a 5 lb propane tank bracket for Flame King tanks. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

The business serves two primary markets: outdoor cooking enthusiasts who buy griddles direct through the company's e-commerce site, and truck owners seeking model-specific mounting hardware. The Tacoma bracket and propane tank bracket illustrate the automotive aftermarket focus, while the griddle series targets the backyard and camp cooking segment.

The company positions itself on "meticulous detail, unapologetic attitude, and technical mastery" and promotes the ability to make "complex shapes easy" through its laser cutting capabilities. It emphasizes custom design and prototyping as a core offering for customers who push limits and demand more.

name: Badger Steel USA.WI LLC
old_description: Metal Fabrication, Powder Coating, Sandblasting, Welding, Forming, custom decor and much more!
about:
Badger Steel USA.WI LLC operates from Cascade, Wisconsin, as a small business producing metal wall decor and custom fabrication. The company does not disclose its founding year or founders publicly.

The shop runs metal fabrication, powder coating, sandblasting, welding, and forming to create over 200 customizable products. Its catalog spans monogrammed wedding gifts, address plaques, crosses, wildlife silhouettes, Wisconsin sports themes, and organizational mounts such as the Milwaukee Packout Mount. All pieces are cut from 14-gauge American steel and finished with a weather-resistant powder coat.

Customers are primarily retail consumers purchasing for home decor or gifting—wedding monograms, family crosses, deer address plaques, and dragonfly art appear in testimonials. The company also serves tradespeople needing rugged tool-storage mounts. No industrial or OEM clients are mentioned in the available material.

Badger Steel emphasizes its 'Badger Steel Guarantee': a small-business commitment to seamless online ordering, fast free shipping nationwide, and responsive service. The brand highlights domestic sourcing—100% American steel, handcrafted in Wisconsin—and a durable powder-coat finish rated for indoor and outdoor exposure.

name: Bailey Metal Fabricators, Inc.
old_description: Bailey Metal Fabricators Inc. Ornamental Metal has been providing ornamental design and fabrication services to Commercial, Industrial and Residential clients since 1960.
about:
Bailey Metal Fabricators, Inc. has operated from Mitchell, South Dakota since its founding in 1960. The family‑run business began as an ornamental metal shop and has grown into a full‑service fabrication house serving customers across the United States.

The company provides custom metal fabrication and ornamental ironwork, producing structural steel components, metal stairs, gates, railings, and stainless‑steel countertops. Its shop runs a CNC plasma cutting system, a 300‑ton Cincinnati CNC press brake, a Hyd‑Mech CNC band saw with material bundling, and a Marvel CNC vertical band saw capable of 45‑degree miter cuts. The operation handles projects from single pieces to larger production runs, though specific volume figures are not published.

Bailey Metal Fabricators works with commercial, industrial, and residential clients nationwide. Typical projects include architectural metalwork for buildings, custom stair systems for contractors, and countertop fabrication for design firms.

The firm emphasizes a low incident rate and ongoing employee training as markers of its safety culture. Its longevity and family ownership are cited as reasons clients turn to the shop for difficult or non‑standard fabrication challenges.

name: Bakery Equipment & Controls, Inc.
old_description: Let us help set you up for production growth and jump all the inefficiencies that come with machinery.
about:
Bakery Equipment & Controls, Inc. (BEC) is based in Billings, Montana. The company was founded by Mike Ninichuck, who brought over 40 years of bakery industry experience after roles at Consolidated Biscuit and Ralcorp where he helped build and consolidate facilities. Ninichuck owns and operates the business today.

BEC designs and builds custom bakery equipment, specializing in complete line installations for cookie, cracker, snack, and pet treat production. The shop provides equipment removal, installation, relocation, refurbishment, repair, inspection, and tear-down services, along with process consulting and efficiency assessments. The company reports a staff of 30-plus, more than 200 clients served, and over 2,000 pieces of equipment supplied from a large used-equipment inventory.

Customers range from small bakeries expanding operations to large-scale producers such as Ralcorp and Consolidated Biscuit. BEC works across the United States and internationally, handling projects of any size in the cookie, cracker, snack, and pet treat sectors.

The firm emphasizes integrity and problem-solving on the spot, drawing on a combined 50 years of hands-on equipment experience. It states that its bids come in well below competitors while delivering higher-quality results, and it offers complete tear-down services to lower the cost of new equipment purchases.
